newsitem.title: USA: Tandy Brands Accessories names Ninemire CFO.
newsitem.headline: Tandy Brands Accessories names Ninemire CFO.

text.p: Tandy Brands Accessories Inc said it hired Stanley Ninemire as its chief financial officer to replace Bruce Cole, who resigned earlier this month.
Ninemire, 41, will assume his responsibilities at the company on Jan. 1, the company said.
He had most recently been senior vice president of finance and operations for Thomson Corp's Practitioners Publishing Co unit.
He had been chief financial officer of Tandy Brands from 1991 through June 1995, the company added.
